description: Composition and work-area commands: Trim Comp to Work Area, Crop Comp to Region of Interest (needs a region drawn in the Composition panel), Set Poster Time, Lift Work Area and Extract Work Area (on the given layers, or all), set the work area to the layers' span, Composition Flowchart, and Reveal Composition in Project. The menu commands make the composition active

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: lift_work_area, extract_work_area and work_area_to_layers: the layers (default all; for work_area_to_layers the selection, else the whole composition). Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

time.description: set_poster_time: seconds; default the current time

name: run_comp_command
title: Run Comp Command
